title: lane r4 Meth: consolidation survivor's label set unspecified — security domain droppable
description: Lane round 4. Lens: methodology (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: symptoms sharing a root cause need not share labels; a security-labeled symptom absorbed into an unlabeled survivor removes the security domain from the fix composition — the motivating incident reintroduced through the amendment's own path. Citations verified: contract:81, :89, :85. Proposed: resolved-candidate (survivor carries the union of absorbed labels; consolidation can never narrow composition).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the survivor carries the union of the absorbed findings' labels — consolidation can never narrow the composition; an absorbed security label still summons the security domain. Revision: consolidation clause.
